signals.entity: Sense Bank — OPEN: HSM support (at qualification)

UAH 1,539,094.66 excl. VAT. Bids closed 30/07/2026; status active.qualification with a PENDING award of UAH 1,528,325 to TOV "SVIT IT" (EDRPOU 34540291). TOV "ALTAIR-775" (25197618) also bid.
signals.implies: Third Ukrainian bank buying payShield support on the open market in 2026, and only two local integrators compete. Confirms a repeatable HSM services niche for Printec across UA.
signals.likelihood: Award expected within days; annual renewal
signals.followup: Diary the 2027 renewal; SVIT IT (34540291) and ALTAIR-775 (25197618) are the two incumbents to displace.

signals.signal: Two OPEN Oschadbank lots as at 01/08/2026: UA-2026-07-30-007518-a "safes", est. UAH 1,951,000, bids close 13/08/2026; and UA-2026-07-28-010842-a uninterruptible power supplies, est. USD 42,000, bids close 10/08/2026.
signals.implies: Peripheral to the core Printec lines (safes belong with cash-handling/security fit-out; UPS supports ATM/branch uptime) but they show Oschadbank is actively buying branch cash-infrastructure right now.
signals.likelihood: Closing within 2 weeks
signals.followup: Screen the safe specification for cash-deposit/recycler compatibility; otherwise no-bid.

signals.likelihood: Annual service contract
signals.followup: Consider a combined "ATM + lobby security + monitoring" managed-service proposition for UA banks.

coverage_notes: Resumed the partial checkpoint from this run (1 signal) and completed the research. PRIMARY-SOURCE BREAKTHROUGH: the previously logged block "Prozorro public search ignores buyer/text filters and there is no public friendly-ID -> UUID resolver" is only half true. (a) POST https://prozorro.gov.ua/api/search/tenders with {"text":"<term>","page":N} DOES work (page is 1-based; page=0 returns HTTP 422; per_page is fixed at 20; multi-word phrases return 0 so use single words). (b) The buyer filter genuinely does NOT work - {"procuringEntity":["<edrpou>"]} returns total 0, and an "edrpou" key is silently ignored - so that block is CONFIRMED. (c) NEW WORKING ROUTE for winners: GET https://clarity-project.info/tender/<friendlyID> (200 with a desktop UA) exposes the Prozorro tender UUID, which then resolves on the OFFICIAL CDB at https://public-api.prozorro.gov.ua/api/2.5/tenders/<uuid>, returning awards (supplier name + EDRPOU + date + amount), all bidders, contracts and line items. This makes every award machine-readable and is the route used for every figure above. Work done: read the Tier-0 cache /Users/mangian/Downloads/BANKING/intel-cache/prozorro_notices.json (362 notices; 82 PrivatBank, 19 Oschadbank, 261 other) and resolved ALL 83 bank/postal notices from 2024-2026 through the CDB. Then ran an independent keyword sweep of the live Prozorro search in Ukrainian and English (банкомат/банкомати/банкоматів, ПТКС, POS-термінал, HSM, payShield, купюроприймач, ресайклер, касети, еквайринг, поштомат, самообслуговування, інкасації, банкнот, Verifone, Ingenico, PAX, Castles, сортування банкнот, лічильно-сортувальн, оброблення банкнот, детектор валют, лічильник банкнот, Укрпошта, Ощадбанк, Укргазбанк, ПриватБанк, Сенс Банк) — 7,403 notices harvested, 160 with bank/postal buyers in 2025-26 — and resolved a further 55 tenders through the CDB. The cache keyword set (банкомат/самообслуговув/кіоск/платіжний термінал) MISSED the entire HSM, banknote-sorting, POS-servicing and Ukrposhta beats; those are the bulk of what is new here. GENUINE GAPS: (1) Ukraine has no PrivatBank "800-ATM 2026" hardware lot - the 800 figure is the 800x NCR SelfServ 2062 line inside the already-won Jan-2025 1,140-unit contract, and no new PrivatBank ATM-hardware notice exists on Prozorro as at 01/08/2026; this is a correction to the baseline, not a gap. (2) Ukraine's PRIVATE banks (Raiffeisen Bank Aval, PUMB, OTP, Universal/monobank, Credit Agricole, TAScombank, A-Bank, Pivdennyi) are not subject to Prozorro and publish nothing - no public tender trail exists for them, which is itself the finding. (3) tender.privatbank.ua and tender.uub.com.ua remain Angular SPAs; every PrivatBank PB-* reference above was recovered instead from the mirrored Prozorro contract-award report, so nothing was lost. (4) zakupivli.pro (referenced in several Ukrgasbank notice titles) stays Cloudflare-JS gated; again the Prozorro mirror carried the data.
access_issues: BLOCKED / NOT OPENED, with the route tried: (1) https://prozorro.gov.ua/tender/<id> - Vue SPA, returns an 842-byte shell; defeated by using the CDB API instead. (2) https://public-api.prozorro.gov.ua/api/2.5/tenders/<friendlyID> - HTTP 404, the CDB only accepts the 32-hex UUID; defeated via clarity-project.info. (3) POST https://prozorro.gov.ua/api/search/tenders with {"procuringEntity":["14360570"]} - accepted but returns total 0; buyer filtering is genuinely unavailable, so keyword sweeping is the only route. GET on the same path returns HTTP 405. (4) https://dozorro.org/tender/<id> - HTTP 403 even with a desktop User-Agent; not needed once Clarity worked. (5) https://zakupivli.pro/commercial/tenders/... - Cloudflare-JS gated (logged, not re-tried this run). (6) tender.privatbank.ua - Angular SPA, not fetchable. (7) The live search API rate-limits: HTTP 429 after sustained paging, and multi-word queries return 0 rather than an error. Claude-in-Chrome was NOT needed this run - the CDB route made every target machine-readable, so no page required a browser.
operator_requests: None required. Everything cited was fetched directly.
